edges.text: General entry requirements and English level 2, or English 6

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 1 läses delkurs LY1 (4,5 hp) som är en del av kursen Logopedens yrkesroll. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: In term 1 the sub-course LY1 (4.5 credits), part of Professional Development (30 credits in total), is taken.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 2 läses delkurs LY2 (5 hp) som är en del av kursen Logopedens yrkesroll. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: Sub-course LY2 (5 hp) is taken during semester 2 as part of the 30-credit Professional Development course.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 3 läses delkurs LY3 (1,5 hp) som är en del av kursen Logopedens yrkesroll. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: The 1.5-credit sub-course LY3 taken in semester 3 is part of the Professional Development course, which totals 30 credits.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 4 läses delkurs LY4 (5,5 hp) som är en del av kursen Logopedens yrkesroll. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: During semester 4, sub-course LY4 (5.5 credits), which is part of Professional Development (30 credits in total), is taken.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 5 läses delkurs LY5 (3 hp) som är en del av kursen Logopedens yrkesroll. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: In semester 5, the 3-credit sub-course LY5, part of the Professional Development course, is taken; the course totals 30 credits.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 6 läses delkurs LY6 (4,5 hp) som är en del av kursen Logopedens yrkesroll. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: In semester 6 the sub-course LY6 (4.5 credits) is taken as part of the Professional Development course, which totals 30 credits.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 6 läses delkurs 1 (3 hp) del av kursen Forskningsmetodik och statistik. Kursen omfattar totalt 7,5 hp.

result.labelEn: During term 6, part 1 (3 credits) of the Research Methodology and Statistics course is taken; the course totals 7.5 credits.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 7 läses del 1 (6,5 hp) av kursen Examensarbete i logopedi. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: Part 1 (6.5 credits) of the Degree Project in Speech-Language Pathology is taken in semester 7; the course totals 30 credits.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 7 läses delkurs LY7 (4 hp) som är en del av kursen Logopedens yrkesroll. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: Semester 7 includes the 4-credit sub-course LY7, which is part of the 30-credit Professional Development course.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 8 läses delkurs 2 (4,5 hp) del av kursen Forskningsmetodik och statistik. Kursen omfattar totalt 7,5 hp.

result.labelEn: Sub-course 2 (4.5 hp) of Research Methodology and Statistics is taken in semester 8, and the course totals 7.5 hp.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 8 läses delkurs LY8 (2 hp) som är en del av kursen Logopedens yrkesroll. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: During semester 8, the 2-credit sub-course LY8, part of Professional Development, is taken; the course totals 30 credits.

note.textSv: OBS: Under termin 8 läses del 2 (23,5 hp) av kursen Examensarbete i logopedi. Kursen omfattar totalt 30 hp.

result.labelEn: Part 2 (23.5 credits) of the Degree Project in Speech-Language Pathology is taken in semester 8; the course totals 30 credits.
